summary: A Toronto real estate and wills firm appears to lose trust to unfinished cookie text, an old footer year and scattered phone numbers.

findings.problem: The cookie notice appears to show unfilled placeholders such as {vendor_count} and {title}.
findings.cost: Template code on the first screen looks unfinished to a client about to share personal details.
findings.fix: A working cookie banner with real wording.

findings.problem: Four different phone numbers appear across the page.
findings.cost: Clients do not know which office or line to call and may give up.
findings.fix: One main number and a clear office list.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read 2025 beside a web design credit.
findings.cost: An old year suggests the site is not kept up to date.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears and the menu lists a very long set of practice items.
findings.cost: Long menus and no quick message path hide the main call to action.
findings.fix: A shorter menu and WhatsApp on every page.
